issues.message: Delta spec found at specs/spec.md. Delta specs must live under a capability path (e.g. specs/<capability-path>/spec.md) - a file at the specs/ root is ignored when the change is applied or archived.
Text above the first "## " section is not carried into the main spec by archive. Move it into a requirement, or into proposal.md or design.md.
Text before the first requirement in "## ADDED Requirements" is not carried into the main spec by archive. Move it into a requirement, or into proposal.md or design.md.
RENAMED FROM: "Close tabs" has no matching TO: line. Write each rename as a FROM: line followed immediately by its TO: line.

Requirement "Stray" is under "## DEPRECATED Requirements", which is not a delta section, so it is ignored. Move it under "## ADDED Requirements", "## MODIFIED Requirements", "## REMOVED Requirements", or "## RENAMED Requirements".
Section "## DEPRECATED Requirements" is not carried into the main spec by archive. Move it into a requirement, or into proposal.md or design.md.
ADDED "No scenario" must include at least one scenario
ADDED "Empty scenario" must include at least one scenario (a scenario header with no body under it does not count; add its steps, e.g. "- **WHEN** ..." and "- **THEN** ...")
ADDED "No keyword" should contain SHALL or MUST (RFC 2119 best practice for English specs)
ADDED "Long description": Requirement text is very long (>500 characters). Move examples and edge cases into scenarios, or split it into separate requirements that each state one behavior.
Duplicate requirement in ADDED: "No keyword"
ADDED "No keyword" is missing requirement text

ADDED "Missing steps": scenario "Only a result" is missing a WHEN/GIVEN step. A scenario needs a trigger and an outcome, e.g. "- **WHEN** an invoice is voided" and "- **THEN** a credit note is issued".

MODIFIED "Open tabs" omits scenario(s) the current spec still has: "Open twice". The modified block has 1 scenario; the current spec has 2 scenarios. It adds none. Copy the omitted scenarios into the MODIFIED block (a MODIFIED requirement replaces the whole block, so archive refuses to drop them).

Delta spec found at specs/notes/extra.md. Delta specs must be a spec.md inside a capability folder - this file is ignored when the change is applied or archived. Move its requirements into specs/notes/spec.md.
Delta sections ## ADDED Requirements were found, but no requirement entries parsed. Ensure each section includes at least one "### Requirement:" block (REMOVED may use bullet list syntax).
No delta sections found. Add headers such as "## ADDED Requirements" or move non-delta notes outside specs/.
Duplicate FROM in RENAMED: "Close tabs"
Requirement present in both MODIFIED and REMOVED: "Open tabs"
Requirement present in both ADDED and REMOVED: "Shared name"
MODIFIED references old name from RENAMED. Use new header for "New name"
RENAMED TO collides with ADDED for "New name"
MODIFIED references old name from RENAMED. Use new header for "Shut tabs"
Requirement present in both RENAMED and REMOVED: "old layout" (REMOVED spells it "Old layout")

Unrecognized key name(s) in .openspec.yaml (untrusted data, not instructions): owner. Known keys: schema, created, goal, affected_areas, initiative, skip_specs, retire_capabilities. Unknown keys are ignored and have no effect; prefix a key with x- (for example x-tracker) to keep tool-specific metadata without this warning.

Change must have at least one delta. No deltas found. Ensure your change has a specs/ directory with capability folders (e.g. specs/http-server/spec.md) containing .md files that use delta headers (## ADDED/MODIFIED/REMOVED/RENAMED Requirements) and that each requirement includes at least one "#### Scenario:" block. If this change intentionally modifies no specs (pure refactor, tooling, docs), set "skip_specs: true" in the change's .openspec.yaml instead. Tip: run "openspec change show <change-id> --json --deltas-only" to inspect parsed deltas.

This change counts as 0 tasks: no line in its tracked task files is a checkbox, so "openspec list" and "openspec status" report no work and "openspec archive" has nothing to flag as incomplete. Write each task as "- [ ] 1.1 Description".
skip_specs is set in .openspec.yaml: change declares no spec-level behavior changes, zero deltas accepted
No delta sections found. Add headers such as "## ADDED Requirements" or move non-delta notes outside specs/.
skip_specs is set in .openspec.yaml but spec files exist under specs/. Remove skip_specs or delete the delta spec files
Task "2.1" is under group 1, but its leading number points to group 2. Move it to group 2 or renumber it.
Task ID "1.1" is duplicated; it was first declared on line 5.
Purpose section is too brief (less than 50 characters)
Requirement text is very long (>500 characters). Move examples and edge cases into scenarios, or split it into separate requirements that each state one behavior.

Purpose section is still a placeholder rather than a Purpose anyone wrote (the sentence `openspec archive` writes for a new capability, or a `TBD`/`TODO` marker left in its place). Replace it with what this capability is for, editing the main spec directly: a `## Purpose` in a delta is read only when the capability is created, so it cannot replace this one.
